ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/light-grey) central regions (~65%) contrasted with a low-intensity (black/dark-grey) trailing edge perimeter (~10%) and significant mid-intensity orange-brown staining (~25%)
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, irregular orange-brown pigment clusters centrally located and extending into the lower lobes. Discrete circular dark outlines with high-intensity centers (ring-scars) localized on the left mid-lobe. Low-intensity (black) pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex; estimated angle of 35-40 degrees with a depth extending roughly 10% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (serrations) along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by sharp peaks and jagged valleys, particularly dense on the outer lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trailing edge curve sweeping upward toward pointed, jagged distal tips; the leading edge appears roughly linear but terminates in highly textured, irregular distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular ring-shaped scars (dark perimeters with light centers) clustered on the far left lobe. Dense, high-relief nodular clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme distal tips and along the upper trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-5 near-vertical, parallel dark linear marks (rake marks) visible on the mid-to-lower section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive orange-brown biological staining (diatom film) across the ventral surface; heavy barnacle encrustation on the distal lobe tips causing significant geometric irregularity to the fluke silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct 'O'-shaped scarring pattern on the left lobe, appearing as three vertically aligned circular marks.
